Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Generates random inputs for [PgPropertyRunner](/api/ankus.pgpropertyrunner/), the counterpart of a proptest strategy.

```csharp
public sealed class PgGenerator<T>
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The generated value.

Create generators with [PgGenerators](/api/ankus.pggenerators/) and compose them with [Select&lt;TResult&gt;(Func&lt;T, TResult&gt;)](/api/ankus.pggenerator-1/#member-35d58d9f353acbe9),
[Where(Func&lt;T, bool&gt;)](/api/ankus.pggenerator-1/#member-273c9f3f3b1d45c8) and LINQ query syntax. Every composed generator shrinks a failing input toward simpler values
without extra code: numbers toward zero, strings and arrays toward fewer and simpler elements, and choices toward
the first alternative.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### Where(Func&lt;T, bool&gt;)

Keeps only values that satisfy a condition, as proptest's <code>prop_filter</code> does.

```csharp
public PgGenerator<T> Where(Func<T, bool> predicate)
```

Parameters:

`predicate` — [Func&lt;T, bool&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2)

The condition.

Returns: [PgGenerator&lt;T&gt;](/api/ankus.pggenerator-1/)

A generator that draws again when the condition fails.

After 100 failed draws for one input, the runner rejects that case and generates another. A run fails when it
rejects more cases than [MaxRejects](/api/ankus.pgpropertyoptions/#member-86d1ebf2d55f374a) allows, so prefer constructing valid values
with [Select&lt;TResult&gt;(Func&lt;T, TResult&gt;)](/api/ankus.pggenerator-1/#member-35d58d9f353acbe9) over discarding most of them.
